title: SAKI-RoPE: Score-Aware Low-Rank Key Indexing with RoPE-Aware Covariance and Random-Matrix Noise Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.03228v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing low-rank KV-cache indexes preserve model weights or key variance, not the attention scores that determine retrieval. We derive the expected score distortion of key-side rank-r compression, a two-sided covariance-weighted low-rank problem that uses both query and key statistics, and solve it exactly: the optimum is an optimal rank-r linear score map, computed in closed form from two d x d covariances per head, and its predicted per-head score-MSE reduction matches measurement (Pearson r = 0.997). The resulting training-free index, SAKI, beats key-PCA at every rank on LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B, at every context length from 4K to 64K, and in every calibration-domain pair (0.748 -> 0.799 recall@64 at r = 32 on LLaMA-3.1-8B). Because RoPE rotates keys by their distance from the query, we make the closed form RoPE-aware by averaging the query covariance over rotations; this SAKI-RoPE, our main method, r

translated_title: SAKI-RoPE：基于RoPE感知协方差与随机矩阵噪声分析的分数感知低秩键索引
translated_abstract: 现有的低秩KV缓存索引保留的是模型权重或键的方差，而非决定检索效果的注意力分数。我们推导了键侧rank-r压缩的期望分数失真——这是一个同时利用查询与键统计信息的双边协方差加权低秩问题——并对其进行精确求解：最优解是一个最优的rank-r线性分数映射，可由每个注意力头的两个d×d协方差以闭式形式计算得出，且其预测的逐头分数MSE降低与实测结果高度吻合（Pearson r = 0.997）。由此得到的免训练索引SAKI，在LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B和Llama-3.2-3B上的所有秩、4K至64K的所有上下文长度、以及所有校准域配对下均优于key-PCA（在LLaMA-3.1-8B上r=32时recall@64从0.748提升至0.799）。由于RoPE会根据键与查询的距离对键进行旋转，我们通过对旋转下的查询协方差取平均，使闭式解具备RoPE感知能力；这一SAKI-RoPE即我们的主要方法（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出SAKI-RoPE——一种免训练的低秩KV缓存索引方法，通过闭式求解查询-键双边协方差加权的最优rank-r线性分数映射，并对RoPE旋转下的查询协方差取平均使其具备旋转位置编码感知能力，从而在多个模型、所有秩和上下文长度下全面超越key-PCA。
